g.text: Combinatorial purged cross-validation cuts one price history into N groups and tests every
combination of k held-out groups, purging bars that overlap the training set. Each
combination yields one out-of-sample path. The leaderboard reports the median annualised
Sharpe across those paths, because the mean is pulled by one lucky path.
· IQR — how much the paths disagree; wide means fragile.
· Paths positive — share of paths above zero.
· Trades — under 10 the row is listed, never ranked.
Combos beat single rules on SOL 1d
Edge does not transfer to DOGE
Seen on: Research › Leaderboard, Signal › Evidence, P&L
